question_or_proposition: For Chlordane at Outfall 001, does the Part I limits-and-monitoring row establish (a) any enforceable numeric effluent discharge limit, (b) a required monitoring and reporting obligation at the stated frequency, or (c) neither?
required_context: Chlordane row and adjacent pollutant rows with the same N/A/Report pattern in Part I Section A
Table column headers for 30-day average, daily maximum, and 7-day average limit columns versus measurement frequency and sample type columns
Permit usage of 'N/A' and 'Report' across limit and reporting columns in this table section
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page 4, Section part_i, Chlordane row
notes: The nominated row shows N/A in all numeric limit columns, Report in the 7-day average column, and 1/Quarter grab monitoring. How those fields combine affects whether numeric exceedance comparison applies (Purpose A), whether quarterly monitoring was required (Purpose B), and how absent or report-only Chlordane results are classified (Purpose C).
